keyPoints.en: Tabayyun (al-Hujurat: 6): verify news before believing or sharing.
keyPoints.bm: Tabayyun (al-Hujurat: 6): selidiki berita sebelum mempercayai atau berkongsi.

keyPoints.en: Respect privacy; never spread fitnah or others' secrets.
keyPoints.bm: Hormati privasi; jangan sebarkan fitnah atau rahsia orang.

keyPoints.en: Use polite language; online words are recorded too.
keyPoints.bm: Gunakan bahasa sopan; kata-kata di talian turut dicatat.

tip.en: Ask yourself: Would I say this face to face?
tip.bm: Tanya diri: Adakah saya akan berkata begini secara bersemuka?

keyPoints.en: Good friend = perfume seller; bad friend = blacksmith (al-Bukhari, Muslim).
keyPoints.bm: Sahabat baik = penjual minyak wangi; sahabat buruk = tukang besi (al-Bukhari, Muslim).

keyPoints.en: "A person is upon the religion of his close friend" — choose carefully.
keyPoints.bm: "Seseorang mengikut agama sahabat karibnya" — pilih dengan teliti.

keyPoints.en: Rights: salam, visit the sick, accept invitations, give sincere advice.
keyPoints.bm: Hak: salam, ziarah yang sakit, penuhi jemputan, beri nasihat ikhlas.

keyPoints.en: Mahmudah: honesty, patience, humility, amanah, ithar.
keyPoints.bm: Mahmudah: jujur, sabar, rendah diri, amanah, ithar.

keyPoints.en: Mazmumah: arrogance, envy, lying, khianat, riak.
keyPoints.bm: Mazmumah: sombong, dengki, bohong, khianat, riak.

keyPoints.en: Good character is the heaviest on the Mizan; the Prophet ﷺ was sent to perfect it.
keyPoints.bm: Akhlak baik paling berat di Mizan; Rasulullah ﷺ diutus untuk menyempurnakannya.
